message.reasoning_content:
The watch: Omega De Ville, white/silver dial with Roman numerals at 12, 3, 6, 9 and applied baton indices, date at 3, "Co-Axial Chronometer" text, black leather strap, stainless steel case. Likely Omega De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 36.8mm or 39.5mm. Reference 424.13.40.20.02.001 (De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 39.5mm, silver dial, leather strap). Actually 424.13.40.20.02.001 is the 39.5mm version with silvery dial. The 36.8mm is 424.13.33.20.52.001 etc. Hmm.

The dial with Roman numerals at quarters and "Co-Axial Chronometer" — this looks like De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 39.5mm ref 424.13.40.20.02.001. Actually let me recall: 424.13.40.20.02.001 = De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 39.5 mm, stainless steel on leather strap, silvery dial. Yes that seems right. There's also 424.13.40.20.02.002 with blue dial.

Hmm, but the dial has a mix: Roman numerals at 12/3/6/9 would be... Actually looking closely, at 12 there's a Roman numeral XII, at 3 the date window, at 6 Roman numeral VI, at 9 Roman numeral IX. The others are baton indices. That's a distinctive design.

Actually I recall the De Ville Prestige 39.5mm with "silvery dial" having Roman numerals and baton markers — yes, ref 424.13.40.20.02.001. Hmm, but I think 424.13.40.20.02.001 has baton markers only... The one with mixed Roman numerals might be 424.13.40.20.02.004? Let me think.

There's the De Ville Prestige "Orbis" edition... no.

I'll go with 424.13.40.20.02.001, confidence moderate ~0.3.

Movement: automatic (Co-Axial cal 2500). Case: stainless steel. Bracelet: leather.
